title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E06 — Obsessions Gone Too Far
A teacher is accused of being a sex offender; a woman is obsessed with her next-door neighbors.

title: Secret Life of a Good Wife
description: Jenna is an influencer with a traumatic past who finds peace, love and internet fame as a traditional housewife. When her mother goes missing, she soon realizes the kind and loving community she's come to rely on harbors dark secrets.

title: Here Kills the Bride
description: Jasmine finds out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. Jasmine investigates the reasons for the marriage and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

title: Don't Scream, It's Me
description: Fifteen years ago, Liz's ex-boyfriend, Drew, was caught robbing a bank. Now, he's in her backyard, asking her to hide him after a prison escape.

title: My Life Is a Lifetime Movie
description:
S01 E07 — Someone Is Trying to Ruin My Life
A woman fights back when a district attorney threatens to charge her pregnant 14-year-old daughter as a pornographer; an aspiring opera singer receives an offer.

title: Death She Wrote
description: A famous author hires a personal assistant to work out of her home, not realizing that the woman is actually a deranged fan who plans on taking over her entire life.

description: The purported self-help group NXIVM traps thousands and targets the minds and bodies of young women from around the country; actress Catherine Oxenberg shares her personal fight to get her daughter out of the outrageous cult.
